title: SQLite Write-Ahead Logging — WAL Concurrency and Same-Host Requirement
locator: Sections 1 and 2.2: WAL shared-memory wal-index requires processes on the same host; WAL is not supported over network filesystems; a WAL file permits one writer at a time.
notes: Used to limit the atomic reference mode to a supported local filesystem on one host. It does not imply distributed or multi-host transaction semantics.
